verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring transfers or workflows is a fair axis for a banking API platform, but the evidence never documents a recurring schedule or scheduled-job capability. It only covers one-off API calls such as POST /ach_transfers and POST /wire_transfers, event-driven webhooks, and account holds. Customers submitting at every Fed window describes their own orchestration, not a scheduling feature Increase provides.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
